```{r, echo=FALSE}
 # cat("⚠️  DEVELOPMENT MODE - Using cache only\n")

  #cat("📡 PRODUCTION MODE\n")

#}

# ============================================
# Bulk load using API with smart retry logic
# ============================================

library(httr)
library(xml2)

#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| 
cache_file <- "arxiv_cache_bulk.rds"

end_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
start_date <- format(Sys.Date() - 30, "%Y%m%d")  # Last 30 days

search_query <- paste0(
  "(cat:cs.lg+OR+cat:cs.ai)+AND+submittedDate:[",
  start_date, "0000+TO+",
  end_date, "2359]"
)


all_records <- data.frame()

# Fetch multiple pages with smart retry logic
for (start in seq(0, 500, 50)) {
  
  cat("Fetching records", start, "to", start + 50, "...\n")
  
  api_url <- paste0(
    "http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=",
    URLencode(search_query),
    "&start=", start,
    "&max_results=50&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending"
  )
  
  # Long wait between requests
  Sys.sleep(15)
  
  # Retry logic for 429 and 503 errors
  max_retries <- 3
  retry_count <- 0
  response <- NULL
  
  while (retry_count < max_retries && is.null(response)) {
    retry_count <- retry_count + 1
    
    tryCatch({
      response <- GET(api_url, timeout(120))
      
      status <- status_code(response)
      #cat("Status:", status, "\n")
      
      if (status == 200) {
        # Success!
        #cat("✓ Request successful\n")
        
      } else if (status == 429 || status == 503) {
        # Get wait time from Retry-After header
        retry_after <- headers(response)$`retry-after`
        
        if (!is.null(retry_after)) {
          # Try to parse as seconds
          wait_time <- as.numeric(retry_after)
          
          if (is.na(wait_time)) {
            # If not a number, it might be an HTTP date
            #cat("Retry-After header:", retry_after, "\n")
            wait_time <- 120  # Default to 2 minutes
          }
        } else {
          # No Retry-After header, use exponential backoff
          wait_time <- 30 * (2 ^ (retry_count - 1))  # 30, 60, 120 seconds
        }
        
        #cat("Rate limited (", status, "). Waiting", wait_time, "seconds...\n")
        Sys.sleep(wait_time)
        response <- NULL  # Reset to trigger retry
        
      } else {
        cat("Error: Status", status, "\n")
        response <- NULL
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Request error:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    })
  }
  
  # Process response if successful
  if (!is.null(response) && status_code(response) == 200) {
    
    tryCatch({
      content <- content(response, as = "text")
      xml_data <- read_xml(content)
      
      ns <- c(atom = "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom",
              arxiv = "http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom")
      
      entries <- xml_find_all(xml_data, "//atom:entry", ns = ns)
      
      if (length(entries) == 0) {
        cat("No more records. Stopping.\n")
        break
      }
      
      
      # Extract authors - collapse multiple authors per entry
      authors <- sapply(entries, function(entry) {
      author_names <- xml_text(xml_find_all(entry, "atom:author/atom:name", ns = ns))
      paste(author_names, collapse = "; ")  # Join multiple authors with semicolon
})

      
      batch <- data.frame(
        title = xml_text(xml_find_all(entries, "atom:title", ns = ns)),
        author = authors,
        arxiv_id = sub("http://arxiv.org/abs/", "", 
                       xml_text(xml_find_all(entries, "atom:id", ns = ns))),
        primary_category = xml_attr(xml_find_all(entries, "arxiv:primary_category", ns = ns), "term"),
        arxiv_url = xml_text(xml_find_all(entries, "atom:id", ns = ns)),
        pdf_url = xml_attr(xml_find_all(entries, "atom:link[@title='pdf']", ns = ns), "href"),
        published = xml_text(xml_find_all(entries, "atom:published", ns = ns)),
        summary = xml_text(xml_find_all(entries, "atom:summary", ns = ns)),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      all_records <- rbind(all_records, batch)
      cat("✓ Total records so far:", nrow(all_records), "\n\n")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error parsing response:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    })
    
  } else {
    cat("Failed to get successful response after", max_retries, "retries. Stopping.\n")
    break
  }
}

# Filter and save
if (nrow(all_records) > 0) {
  #all_records <- all_records[all_records$primary_category == "cs.LG", ]
  saveRDS(all_records, cache_file)
  cat("\n✓ Bulk cache saved with", nrow(all_records), "records\n")
} else {
  cat("No records retrieved\n")
}

 # API code here
}
```




```{r, echo=FALSE}
flag <- 0
if (!flag) {
  # Create a display dataframe with hyperlinked URLs
 #display_records <- recent_records
  display_records <- all_records
  
  # Make the title clickable and bold
  display_records$title <- paste0(
    '<a href="', all_records$arxiv_url, '" target="_blank" style="text-decoration: none; color: #0066cc;"><strong>', 
    all_records$title, 
    '</strong></a>'
  )
  
  # Create a styled tooltip for summary
  display_records$summary_tooltip <- paste0(
    '<span style="',
    'cursor: help; ',
    'border-bottom: 2px dotted #0066cc; ',
    'color: #0066cc; ',
    'font-weight: bold; ',
    'padding: 2px 4px; ',
    'border-radius: 3px; ',
    'background-color: #f0f0f0;" ',
    'title="', 
    gsub('"', '&quot;', all_records$summary),
    '">',
    #'📄 Abstract',
    'Abstract',
    '</span>'
  )
  
  # Style the category with a badge
  display_records$primary_category <- paste0(
    '<span style="',
    'background-color: #28a745; ',
    'color: white; ',
    'padding: 4px 8px; ',
    'border-radius: 3px; ',
    'font-weight: bold; ',
    'display: inline-block;">',
    all_records$primary_category,
    '</span>'
  )
  
    
  # Select and reorder columns
  display_records <- display_records[, c("published","title", "author" , "primary_category", "summary", "summary_tooltip")]
  
  # Rename columns for display
  colnames(display_records) <- c("Date","Title", "Author(s)", "Category", "Summary", "Abstract")
  
  DT::datatable(display_records, filter = 'top',
    escape = FALSE, 
    rownames = FALSE,
    #caption = 'Most Recent and Searchable arXiv papers ',  
    #caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      #style = 'caption-side: top; text-align: center; font-weight: bold;',
      #'Most Recent arXiv Searchable Published Papers'
    #),
    options = list(
    search = list(regex = TRUE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),  
    pageLength = 10,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100, 200, 300, 500),
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(width = '10%', targets = 0),  # Date
      list(width = '35%', targets = 1),  # Title
      list(width = '25%', targets = 2),   # author
      list(width = '8%', targets = 3),   # Category
      list(visible = FALSE, targets = 4),  # Summary (hidden but searchable)
      list(width = '8%', targets = 5)  # Details (tooltip)
    )
    )
  )
}
```
